review_description: Arrived when he said he would, only took 2 weeks from start to installation.Fast and neat install, friendly crew and Arthur was very good with communication. We had a small issue and he promptly came back and fixed( within a couple of hours on a weekend!)Arthur seems to genuinely want to install a system that suits your expectations as if he was installing his own system.Very happy with the process from start to finish and they managed to supply a larger system than I originally looked for a the lowest price, so great bang for buck, at this stage very pleased with my solar and battery installation
